resultset.statement: SELECT id, k, ((SELECT v FROM t2_inner WHERE t2_inner.k = t2_outer.k) > 0) AS r FROM t2_outer ORDER BY id

-- Contrast: IS NULL over the same replaced scalar subquery, exercising the -- Item_func_isnull container on the same replaced field. SELECT id, k, ((SELECT v FROM t2_inner WHERE t2_inner.k = t2_outer.k) IS NULL) AS r FROM t2_outer ORDER BY id
